Your Johnston project

Get the subfloor and transitions into the estimate.

If your Johnston project starts with removing carpet, vinyl, or an older floor, the surface underneath may change the scope. Tell us about movement, squeaks, soft spots, or visible unevenness. We can review what is accessible and explain where concealed conditions remain uncertain.

A new floor also changes the edges of the room. Door clearance, transitions, base trim, and the landing at a step deserve attention before work starts. Bring those details into the walkthrough so the estimate describes a finished room.

Before your walkthrough

  • Mark any squeaks, movement, or uneven areas.
  • Identify the existing flooring and what needs removal.
  • Show low doors, stair landings, and adjoining floors.

Answers before you start

Johnston flooring questions.

Have a question about your own rooms? Ask for a callback.

Can you install LVP over an uneven floor in Johnston?

The surface must meet the flooring manufacturer's preparation requirements. We assess visible conditions and discuss the preparation needed. LVP should not be treated as a way to hide movement, damage, or unsuitable unevenness.

Will you remove the existing flooring?

Removal can be discussed as part of the project. Tell us the existing material and the rooms involved so removal, disposal, and preparation can be addressed in the written scope. Do not assume these items are included in a material-only price.

Can you fix squeaks while replacing the floor?

Point them out during the walkthrough. Some causes may become clearer when the old covering is removed, and not every noise has a simple flooring fix. We can discuss the accessible condition and any work that needs further assessment.

What if damage is found under the old floor?

Concealed conditions can change what preparation is needed. The initial estimate should identify what is visible and what remains uncertain. Any additional work and price should be discussed before proceeding with a changed scope.

Is the in-home estimate in Johnston free?

Yes. We offer a free in-home estimate. After reviewing the space and your project, we provide a written, itemized scope so you can see what is included before work begins.

How do I request a callback?

Use the form on this page with your name, phone number, town, and project type. You can include a preferred call time. We will contact you about the project and confirm next steps; the requested time is a preference, not a booked appointment. You can also call (401) 602-0958.
